comparison.objective: Twist an ice tray to release cubes, invert it into a dish, and restore the tray.
comparison.physical_skill: Opposed bimanual torsion, inversion, pouring, and placement.
comparison.success_condition: All cubes in dish, tray restored, arms withdrawn and system still.
comparison.reason: Opposed rotation is only a generic primitive; this tests bulk release and pouring rather than fine retained adjustment and repeated dynamic validation.
